import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection


class User(models.Model):
    email = models.EmailField()
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=[("ADMIN", "Admin"), ("REGULAR", "Regular")])

    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"


class Profile(models.Model):
    full_name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    user = models.OneToOneField(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(User)
    se.create_model(Profile)

from django.db.models import Prefetch

user = User.objects.create(email="test@example.com", kind="ADMIN")
Profile.objects.create(user=user, full_name="Test Tester")

queryset = User.objects.only("email").prefetch_related(
    Prefetch(
        "profile",
        queryset=Profile.objects.prefetch_related(
            Prefetch("user", queryset=User.objects.only("kind"))
        ),
    )
)
user = queryset.first()
print("deferred on inner user:", user.profile.user.get_deferred_fields())
assert user.profile.user.kind == "ADMIN", "extra query happened or wrong value"
print("OK: no extra query, kind =", user.profile.user.kind)
